fusions.name: Mile-Weighted Cast
fusions.desc: A throw that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full range, and knocks the target back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Step and Jab
fusions.desc: A jab in stride that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Column on the Road
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Legs Under the Lunge
fusions.desc: When you have covered enough ground, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
